title: Petition of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3 to the Department of Public Utilities for certain exemptions from the Zoning Bylaws of the Towns of Millbury and Auburn, Massachusetts, in connection with the proposed construction of a new 115 kV overhead transmission line.
petitioner: New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: DPU Chairman issues Order consolidating DPU 09-136/09-137
DPU Commissioners designate Robert Shea as hearing officer on zoning matter

New England Power Company files Petitions for exemptions from zoning ordinances relative to proposed construction of a new 115 kV overhead transmission line, pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, §3 in the Towns of Millbury and Auburn
